subject.title: Add grouped Claw schema and read-only add plan

question: Must grouped Claw v1 include an immutable install identity in this foundational schema, or may later lifecycle/provenance slices define identity independently of the mutable agent id?
rationale: Downstream add, ownership, status, remove, export, and update PRs already build on this contract, so changing identity later would create coordinated schema, provenance, and upgrade churn that code review cannot resolve without product intent.

options.title: Settle identity before merge
options.body: Pause this base until RFC review specifies the immutable install identity and updates this schema if required.

options.title: Defer to lifecycle provenance
options.body: Approve this schema with agent id as the manifest identity and require a separate immutable installed-unit id in the mutation/provenance slice.

options.title: Use agent id permanently
options.body: Explicitly accept final agent id as the durable installed-unit identity across add, status, remove, export, and update.

recommendation.title: Settle identity before merge
recommendation.body: Pause this base until RFC review specifies the immutable install identity and updates this schema if required.

likelyOwner.reason: He raised the concrete consumer-facing identity requirement and is the strongest available reviewer for the host-neutral package boundary.
